title: Every client site, checked every 15 minutes
label: Studio status
problem: With a handful of client sites live, I wanted to know a site was down before the client did.
built: A Cloudflare Worker that checks uptime, deploys, CI, Lighthouse, domains and backups for every client site every 15 minutes, and sends an alert to my phone when a site goes down or comes back.
outcome: If your site goes down, my phone tells me, usually before you notice.
